title: Do you travel in your dreams to The Mallworld?
content: Sometimes I just find myself on the Mallworld. Getting there does not even ring a bell. I'm just there, in that maze of walls and cubicles and corridors and small air vents etc that all resemble an old government building. Sometimes Outside the building, streets are filled with kebab shops(I'm from Turkey) But other times I have to go there first and sometimes don't even make it. I take a bus that seems to come from nowhere and drive down a hill, a plane that travel dangerously close to the ocean, a ferry that goes to a place full of skyscrapers and it doesn't really make it to the dock properly so people have to jump, an electric car self-driving car that goes extremely fast and usually in the opposite lane. All of them have one thing in common and they are all going to the Mall Word, even though the route and the surroundings always seem to be unique to each vehicle. Do you have a similar experience?
